text:
Sam Owens: Kickoff for HelioSmart onboarding  target start Mon 2026-07-06. Need final stakeholder roster, 14-day success criteria, and clear owners for infra / enablement / billing. Any procurement/renewal flags we should track? @Priya Patel @Noor Malik @Luis Ortega

Noor Malik: From intake: Sarah Blake (Exec sponsor), Ravi Gupta (Infra), Mei Tan (Data), Finance contact Elena Ruiz pending. CSM flagged a procurement window ~39 days out ":warning:"  mark as medium renewal risk.

Priya Patel: I can run enablement (30-45m). Plan: 20m product/demo, 15m integration examples, 10m Q&A + quick troubleshooting. Will post agenda and invite by EOD. Morning slots preferred for Product.

Luis Ortega: I'll own technical onboarding: env prep, API key provisioning, sample data ingestion, and smoke tests. For Private deployment we need network owner + approved IP ranges. I'll share a pre-onboard checklist tomorrow.

Sam Owens: Draft 14-day success checklist proposal: 1) Staging end-to-end smoke with median gen latency <200ms; 2) Ramp test traffic to ~25% of expected steady-state calls and observe p95 <=400ms; 3) 10 representative prompts meet quality gate (<=5% fail); 4) Console access provisioned for 3 engineers; 5) Billing baseline & first-cost estimate shared. Any edits?

Mei Tan: Add data signoff: if any prompts contain customer PII, we need a data handling attestation and a sanitized test set. Also confirm retention policy for logs.

Priya Patel: +1. I'll include a 3-question feedback form to capture enablement sentiment and one actionable request item per attendee.

onboard-bot: Calendar invite created: "HelioSmart - Enablement" Tue 2026-07-07 16:00 UTC  https://calendar.example/evt/helio-777 :calendar:

Luis Ortega: Pre-checklist draft: - create service account + API key - provide IP allowlist entries - upload sample payloads/schema - grant console access to 3 engineers - share sanitized test prompt set in shared drive

Quick dev sanity curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-v1.3","prompt":"<smoke test>","max_tokens":64}'
```

Sam Owens: Who will own the 14-day health summary (KPIs, blockers, renewal signal, recommended actions)? Need a one-pager and a 15-min readout on day 14.

Noor Malik: I will own the 14-day health summary. I'll draft a one-pager with p50/p95 latency, error rates, quality pass %, adoption signal, blockers, and renewal note (procurement window). Draft by day 12.

Luis Ortega: Uploaded starter folder and checklist: https://drive.example/folder/heliosmart-onboard. Added network contacts doc for firewall/IPs.

Sam Owens: Perfect. I'll add the 39-day procurement review to the Renewal Signals sheet as a medium risk and list mitigations (exec sponsor intro, weekly adoption highlights, and a cost-run scenario). Cadence: enablement Tue, quick go/no-go Fri. :thumbsup:
